description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Handover" name="Order handed over for delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TrackingInfo" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Order">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Company" name="Online Order Fulfillment" processRef="Process_Order"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Feedback" name="Feedback and Return Handling" processRef="Process_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="Part_Customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Handover" name="Hand over order" sourceRef="SendTask_Handover" targetRef="Part_Logistics" messageRef="Msg_Handover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="SendTask_Tracking" targetRef="Part_Customer" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInfo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delivery" name="Delivery confirmed" sourceRef="Part_Logistics" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Delivery" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback or return" sourceRef="Part_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Order" name="Online Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Order">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Online</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Phone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOnline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceByPhone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderSystem" name="Order System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_Confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_Tracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReceiveTask_Delivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ManualTask_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Online" name="Order placed online"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Phone" name="Order placed by phone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOnline" name="Place order via online platform"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceByPhone" name="Place order by phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Confirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Handover" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_Handover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Tracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInfo"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Delivery" name="Monitor shipment until delivery" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Online" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="StartEvent_Phone" targetRef="Task_PlaceByPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnline" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_PlaceByPhone" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="SendTask_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="ManualTask_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="ManualTask_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="SendTask_Handover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_Handover" targetRef="SendTask_Tracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_Tracking" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Delivery" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Feedback" name="Feedback and Return Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Feedback" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_HandleFeedback" name="Handle feedback or return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="StartEvent_Feedback" targetRef="UserTask_HandleFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="UserTask_HandleFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
